headline: Panama Canal Water Shortage Nears 3-Year Low, Global Trade and Logistics Turmoil Intensifies | ETtoday International News
summary: Water shortages affecting the Panama Canal could reduce daily vessel transits to 27 in coming months. Global trade was already strained by the Iran war and disruption in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Panama Canal is a key shipping route between the Atlantic and Pacific, and reduced transits raise freight costs and supply-chain pressure.
